content.short: Prettier Solidity formats Solidity code automatically.
content.description: Prettier Solidity is a plugin that formats Solidity code automatically, significantly improving readability and the consistency of code structure. By taking the hustle out of code organization and formatting, it helps teams collaborating on smart contracts write code that is easier to maintain and scale over time. The project is widely adopted within the Solidity community, with over 30,000 developers worldwide using it.
